descriptor: root-relative reference 3D hand, scale-normalised by its own bone-length sum, then global rotation removed by Procrustes alignment to the view's medoid pose. What remains is articulation only.
distance: Euclidean distance between aligned, scale-normalised joint configurations
DIVERSE_N: greedy farthest-point selection, seeded at the medoid
LOW_DIVERSITY_N: the N poses nearest the medoid
target_independence: no reference focal, no focal error and no fusion outcome takes any part in selection
interpretation_rule: diversity is judged by the PAIRED incremental gain G = err(scene-only) - err(scene+hand) within each subset, never by comparing scene+hand errors across subsets, because the subsets contain different frames
